name: Question 1
problem:
The unit tangent vector to a curve at an arbitrary point is given by

$$
T(t)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1+{t}^{2}}}⟨1,t⟩.
$$

Find the principal normal vector at the point where $t=1.$

The unit tangent vector to a curve at an arbitrary point is given by T(t)=11+t2⟨1,t⟩. Find the principal normal vector at the point where t=1.

a
 ⟨−1,0⟩
b
⟨0,1⟩
c
 ⟨22,−22⟩
d
 ⟨22,22⟩
e
⟨−22,22⟩
